name: matix-the-math-club-windows
description: This is an EXACT 1:1 copy of the club web app. The real `app.html` ships with the program and runs inside a native C# WPF window through WebView2, so every page, feature and pixel matches the original: login, workspace, AI, learn, games hub, chat, ideas, points, notifications, roles, video calls, all of it.
